titulo: One more layer off the rail
caption:
One more layer off the rail

It looks warm from the window. He takes one more layer from the rail anyway, and the street is cold.

An extra layer costs nothing to carry, and it is the one thing you cannot go back for halfway down the street.

For whoever takes a layer even when it looks warm.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A bedroom with a clothes rail on the right holding a red, a yellow and a light blue top. A ink-black block figure with white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and the red top lifts off the rail. A bubble says cold out there. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me deciding it is warm enough, to: took one more layer. it was cold.
